notes: Example only: the driver marks every motion input operator_required because the clone states no travel, speed or force limit. Replace these numbers with the limits of the installed stage before any use; they are not a statement about any device.

position.reason: example only: the absolute travel range of the installed stage is operator knowledge

distance.reason: example only: the permitted relative travel of the installed stage is operator knowledge

speed.reason: example only: the safe native speed range of the installed stage is operator knowledge
